catastrophic floods, a global slowdown, and impacts of the war in Ukraine,

South Asia faces an unprecedented combination of shocks on top of the

lingering scars of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Growth in the region is dampening, says the World Bank in its twice-a-year

update, underscoring the need for countries to build resilience.
